--- !bad_call_inline_yield.sql
GRAPH FinGraph
CALL (p) {
  MATCH (p:Person)-[:Owns]->(a:Account)
  RETURN a
} YIELD a
RETURN a

--- Error
syntax error: testdata/input/gql/!bad_call_inline_yield.sql:5:3: yield is not supported with inline CALL (...) { ... }

   |    ^~~~~
